The first find

Where the
friction hides.

Every engagement starts with a walk through your week. We sit with the people doing the work, follow a request from first call to finished job, and mark every place it stalls.

01

Missed calls

After-hours and busy-hour calls that never become a booking or a follow-up.

02

Manual scheduling

Back-and-forth messages, double entry, and reminders someone has to remember to send.

03

Scattered information

Details split across inboxes, notes, and spreadsheets, so every handoff starts with a search.

You leave with a short map of the friction we found and the one fix worth building first.
